cohort: 397 nulliparous women, giving birth at Motazedi Hospital of Kermanshah during 2011-2012.
finding: There was no significant difference between physiological and non-physiological delivery groups in terms of prolonged labor, laceration, depth of laceration, rupture site, uterine inertia, shoulder dystocia, need for vacuum-assisted delivery (or cesarean section), postpartum anemia or episiotomy; however, there was a significant difference between the two groups in terms of prolonged second stage of labor, anemia before delivery and type of placental abruption.
